## Tutorials

The CEIL() function returns the smallest integer value that is bigger than or 
equal to a number.

Note:This function is equal to theCEILING()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CEIL(25.75);

---

CEIL(
number
)

---

SELECT CEIL(25);
```

## Tutorials

The CEILING() function returns the smallest integer value that is bigger than 
or equal to a number.

Note:This function is equal to theCEIL()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CEILING(25.75);

---

CEILING(
number
)

---

SELECT CEILING(25);
```

## Tutorials

The COS() function returns the cosine of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT COS(2);

## Tutorials

The COT() function returns the cotangent of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT COT(6);

---

COT(
number
)

---

## Tutorials

The COUNT() function returns the number of records returned by a select query.

Note:NULL values are not counted.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT COUNT(ProductID) AS NumberOfProducts FROM Products;

---

expression
)
```
